allow: Bash(kubectl pod enter production core web psql '$DATABASE_URL')

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *"settings.local.json" ]]; then $HOME/dotfiles/bin/claude-merge-local-permissions "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" >&2; fi; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.tsx?$' && { source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null && nvm use && yarn lint:fix "$f"; } || true; } 2>/dev/null || true

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); repo=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.repo.name // empty'); [ -z "$repo" ] && repo=$(basename "$cwd"); git_branch=""; if git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then git_branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$git_branch" ] && git_branch=" ($git_branch)"; fi; pr_num=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.pr.number // empty'); pr_review=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.pr.review_state // empty'); pr_info=""; if [ -n "$pr_num" ]; then pr_info=" | PR #${pr_num}"; [ -n "$pr_review" ] && pr_info="${pr_info} (${pr_review})"; fi; effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); effort_info=""; [ -n "$effort" ] && effort_info=" | effort:${effort}"; status_line="${model} | ${repo}${git_branch}${pr_info}${effort_info}"; if [ -n "$remaining" ]; then remaining_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$remaining"); status_line="${status_line} | ctx:${remaining_int}%"; fi; echo "$status_line"
